title.en: AN ACT EXTENDING THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE LAND TAX IN THE PROVINCE OF MISAMIS FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR UNTIL NOVEMBER FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR.

title.vi: Đạo luật gia hạn thời hạn nộp thuế đất tại Misamis đến ngày 1/11/1904

title.id: Undang-Undang perpanjangan batas pembayaran pajak tanah di Misamis untuk tahun 1904 hingga 1 November 1904
title.ms: Akta melanjutkan tempoh pembayaran cukai tanah di Misamis bagi tahun 1904 hingga 1 November 1904

text.en:
The period for the payment, without penalty, of the land tax for the year nineteen hundred and
four in the Province of Misamis is hereby extended to November first, nineteen hundred and four.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the  Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, June 2, 1904.
